devaluations.title: RT by @TechnoFino: 🚨 MASSIVE HDFC SmartBuy Devaluation Alert! 🚨 ​The GyFTR/WooHoo voucher game has officially changed, and it’s going to hurt if you maximize rewards this way. 📉 ​Effective today, July 1, 2026, accelerated reward points for brand vouchers are capped at a flat 3,000 RP/month. ​Here is the damage: ❌ Infinia / Infinia Metal: 15,000 ➡️ 3,000 (80% SLASH) ❌ Diners Black Metal & BizBlack Metal: 10,000 ➡️ 3,000 ❌ Regalia Gold: 4,000 ➡️ 3,000 ​While the overall monthly caps (like 15K for Infinia) look the same on paper, the voucher playground has been heavily restricted. You'll now have to rely on flights and hotels to hit those maximums. ​Premium cards. Tiny limits. Double-check your limits before loading up vouchers this month! ​Check out the full official limits and scenario breakdowns in the attached table 👇 What's your new strategy for hitting the reward caps?
